name: Breaking Curses
overview: Scripture reveals that blessings and curses are closely connected to obedience and the relationship with God, as seen in God's promise to bless those who bless Abraham and curse those who curse him (Genesis 12:3). The Lord, a jealous God, warns against idolatry and declares that the consequences of sin may affect subsequent generations, extending to the third and fourth generation of those who hate Him (Exodus 20:5; Deuteronomy 5:9; Numbers 14:18). However, God is also merciful and longsuffering, emphasizing both judgment and forgiveness. Furthermore, curses do not come without cause, as Proverbs 26:2 teaches that a curse without reason will not stand. True deliverance from curses is therefore grounded in faithful obedience and reliance on God's mercy.
